name: Arcane Seekers
detailed_description:
Game Overview

This is a turn-based squad tactics game that fuses classic Minesweeper mechanics with deep RPG systems. Recruit adventurers with distinct stats and unique skill sets. As your team levels up, you'll draw from a pool of randomized abilities, allowing for adaptive builds tailored to each encounter. The game emphasizes tight decision-making, synergistic skill combos, and creative theorycrafting. Your ultimate challenge: engineer the perfect build and clear entire maps in a single turn.

Game Features

Random Skill Selection – Build Ever-Changing Strategies
As your characters grow, they’ll be presented with randomized skill choices. Carefully build a synergistic team by matching skills and roles, crafting battle strategies that are full of variety and tactical depth.

Skill Upgrades – Seize the Moment for a Game-Changing Strike
Drawing the same skill multiple times upgrades its level, unlocking more powerful effects and greater strategic potential. Timing is everything—upgrading too early may be wasteful, while waiting for the perfect moment can turn the tide and secure victory in a single decisive move.

Ultimate Tactics – One-Turn Victory Challenge
Every command, every skill cast matters. You'll need careful planning and flawless execution to chain actions and abilities into a seamless, airtight strategy capable of achieving the near-impossible: clearing an encounter in a single turn.

Start Your Journey

Assemble your team and set out in search of legendary arcane treasures. Take on the challenge and craft your own magical legacy—your fantasy adventure starts now!

Trial Version Content

  • The full version will feature 12 characters. The trial version includes 6.

  • The full version will have 24 skills in the random pool. The trial version includes 6.

We warmly invite you to try the demo. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Your support means a lot to us. Please stay tuned for more updates and the full version release!
